verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing documents project management for planning and tracking work, from roadmaps down to everyday tasks, tied to issues. Nothing in the evidence mentions kanban boards, columns, or a board view, so only the general planning-and-tracking part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: any documentation of a kanban/board view, configurable columns, moving items between columns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns

citations.quote: Organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks.
Create issues and manage projects with tools that adapt to your code.
Manage projects and assign tasks to Copilot, all from your mobile device.
